name: RRSOS PCC Resupply
description: A recycle-arrows icon on the window of a storage crate (Container1-3) that refills that crate's empty slots with the item it is meant for: the item its label names, or else its demand (drone supply) when that is exactly one item. It sits above the Trash mod's can when that is shown, otherwise just above the game's sort icon. Also puts /resupply on the terminal, which does the same for every such crate on the planet.

terminalCommands.name: /resupply
terminalCommands.help: top up every labelled or demanded crate (needs the Commands mod's terminal)
